title: Attempt Order
statement: Implement `solve(valid, authed)`. Both are 0 or 1. Return the list of stages that run. Validation always runs. Auth runs only when valid is 1. Service runs only when valid and authed are both 1. The names are `validation`, `auth`, and `service`.
constraints: A bad body does not authenticate
A failed auth does not call the service
hints: Append auth only after a valid body.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The pipeline is validate, then dependencies, then the service.

editorial: The pipeline is validate, then dependencies, then the service. A 422 should not show up as a service call in a fake. A 401 should not either. The list is the stages a test asserts by watching which fakes were touched.
